title: How to Order Custom Text & Logo Emblems | DizzyCustom
meta_description: Learn how to order personalized vehicle emblems from DizzyCustom. Guide to text entry, font styles, sizing, character limits, and custom inquiries.
body_html:
Personalizing a vehicle with a custom name badge, club moniker, or unique vehicle lettering is an exciting upgrade. However, drivers often ask: "How do I submit my custom text or logo, what formatting is required, and how do I make sure the finished emblem fits my vehicle?"

At DizzyCustom, we have streamlined the ordering process to make custom automotive badging as straightforward as ordering any standard aftermarket accessory.

In this guide, we walk you through the ordering workflow, explain font and character limits, describe how custom logos and special requests are evaluated, and provide tips for measuring your vehicle bodywork.

Table of Contents

  1. Step-by-Step Custom Ordering Process
  2. Selecting Fonts and Typography Styles

Step-by-Step Custom Ordering Process

Ordering a personalized vehicle emblem on our store involves four simple steps:

  1. Select Your Style: Choose between our signature one-piece Custom Metal Emblem or one of our dimensional 3D lettering series (Edition, Retro, Soft Stroke, Limited).
  2. Choose Your Dimension and Finish: Pick your desired footprint (from 1x4 up to 4x8 inches) and finish (Matte Black, Mirror Chrome, or Gold Plated).
  3. Enter Custom Text: Type your desired name, letters, or phrase directly into the customization text field on the product page.
  4. Complete Checkout: Review your text spelling carefully before finalizing your order.

Selecting Fonts and Typography Styles

Each DizzyCustom product series features a curated automotive typography style:

  • Block Edition Typography: Bold, authoritative block letters tailored for heavy-duty pickup tailgates and performance SUVs.
  • Retro Vintage Typography: Flowing curves inspired by mid-century automotive nameplates, perfect for classic car restorations and hot rods.
  • Soft Stroke Script: Modern flowing script lettering that provides an elegant personalized touch for luxury sedans and motorcycle tanks.
  • Limited Architectural Font: Crisp, angular character forms designed for modern sports compacts and aggressive show builds.

Sizing Guidelines and Character Limits

To ensure physical stability and aesthetic proportion, each emblem dimension features an optimized character limit:

  • 1x4 Inches (Up to 8 Letters): Ideal for short names, initials, or compact motorcycle mounting zones.
  • 1x6 Inches (Up to 12 Letters): Balanced mid-size profile suitable for trunk deck lids and passenger doors.
  • 1x8 Inches (Up to 16 Letters): Extended horizontal span for full family names or club names on wide tailgates.
  • 2x8 Inches (Up to 8 Letters): Tall, prominent lettering offering bold visibility on truck front grilles and tailgates.
  • 4x4 to 8x8 Inches (Up to 20 Letters): Oversized configurations available in the Soft Stroke series for extended phrases.

[IMAGE: Sampleproductcompressed.png - Font and typography options]

Custom Logos and Special Inquiries

While our standard catalog specializes in custom alphanumeric text and phrases, customers occasionally request custom company logos or special club insignia.

When inquiring about special designs:

  • Vector Artwork Preferred: Clean vector files (SVG, AI, or high-resolution PNG) allow our design team to assess whether line thicknesses meet automotive durability standards.
  • Contacting Support: Send special artwork requests to support@dizzycustom.com for fitment and manufacturing feasibility review.
  • Trademark Notice: DizzyCustom manufactures aftermarket personalized lettering. We do not produce unauthorized OEM trademarked automaker logos.

Quality Control and Production Timelines

Once an order is submitted:

  1. Design Validation: Letter kerning, stroke thickness, and structural continuity are checked digitally.
  2. Precision Fabrication: Emblems are precision-formed and finished with electroplated brightwork or satin matte coatings.
  3. Adhesive Lamination: Pre-applied exterior 3M self-adhesive backing is laminated to the exact rear perimeter.
  4. Protective Packaging: Every order is packaged securely to prevent surface scratching during transit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I include numbers or special punctuation?

Yes. Our custom lettering supports standard numbers, hyphens, and common punctuation marks within the designated character limits.

Can I change my custom text after placing the order?

Because custom manufacturing begins quickly, modification or cancellation requests must be sent to support@dizzycustom.com within 24 hours of purchase.

What is the return policy for personalized emblems?

All personalized items are final sale. If your order arrives defective or damaged, notify support@dizzycustom.com within 7 calendar days with photographs for replacement review.

Where can I check shipping times?

Shipping rates and delivery estimates depend on your destination country and are calculated live at checkout.

How do I install my custom emblem upon delivery?

Clean the vehicle surface thoroughly with 70% isopropyl alcohol, mark an alignment baseline with painter's tape, peel the protective 3M backing, and press firmly for 30 to 60 seconds. Allow 48 to 72 hours before washing the car.
